messages:
anita (Finance): FYI we found an Azure Marketplace settlement hold for partner ResellWave. Invoice AZ-2026-775 shows a subscription_id mismatch: the reseller mapping links subscription RW-900 but usage reported under RW-900-v2. Looks like usage not attributed, partner was billed then refunded and we still owe them a settlement adjustment. Est amount: USD 4,320. @henry @joel please advise.
henry (Partner Ops): We ran a reconcile script and saw two subscription variants created during a SKU rename on 2026-02-28. Partner requested rename; system created RW-900-v2 but did not retire RW-900. I will attach mapping export. @billing-bot can you fetch settlement rows for ResellWave Feb-Mar?
billing-bot: Query done. Found 9 unallocated settlement lines totaling USD 4,320. Created ticket FIN-3670. Lines: AZL-3301..AZL-3309.
joel (Sales): Partner is asking for a quick settlement so they don't miss their month-end. They prefer a settlement adjustment instead of re-invoicing.
meera (RevOps): Drafting credit memo. Need signed rename request and partner billing contact. Henry please upload documents.
henry (Partner Ops): Uploaded rename email and mapping CSV: https://redwood.internal/drive/resellwave-rename. Also added partner billing contact (billing@resellwave.com).
meera (RevOps): Draft credit memo:

``
Credit memo to ResellWave (partner id RW-900)
Amount: USD 4,320
Reason: Azure Marketplace subscription_id mismatch after SKU rename; settlement lines unallocated
Related invoice: AZ-2026-775
GL code: 4211
Ticket: FIN-3670
``

Approvers: @anita, @tom (Finance Lead).
tom (Finance Lead): Approved. Please route to Azure settlement ops and include mapping CSV. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Submitted adjustment request to Azure settlements: ticket AZ-SETTLE-4432. ETA 5-7 business days. FIN-3670 linked.
anita (Finance): I'll post a provisional credit in the close workbook under "pending partner settlements" and notify accounting. Thanks team.
henry (Partner Ops): Notifying partner of expected timeline. :thumbsup:
